intent: Place internal and public destinations on opposite sides of the service with explicit scope boundaries. A new header and date prevent an outward path from silently becoming the same inward event.
source:
**Frame:** A second wide gutter and entirely new lane header introduce another date. The public internet sits to the right; the research environment's internal services sit behind Artifactory to the left.

**Screen / system text:**
`12 JUNE 2026 — 02:35 UTC`

**Provenance:** `documented` + `compressed` — the time change and topology are sourced at the consequence level.
title: Public and internal destinations stay distinct
